name: scry
description: Session-start checks for codebase architecture, running stack, repository health, concurrent activity, machine pressure, and untrusted Markdown. Requires every dispatch to a model to choose that model rather than inherit a default silently — subagents, workflow agents, and metered agent CLIs invoked through Bash — warns on first contact with a large and actively-worked source file, and guards expensive Elixir force-rebuilds. Tells a spawned subagent when the worktree it was handed is behind origin/main, and reports once per session what finished build worktrees are still occupying disk.

interface.shortDescription: See repository and machine state at session start
interface.longDescription: Adds session-start context about codebase architecture, the stack the system actually runs on, repository hygiene, concurrent Claude and Codex activity, local machine pressure, and why every repository Markdown file is untrusted historical material. Also installs one PreToolUse hook that DENIES a first attempt at an artifact-discarding Elixir rebuild (`mix compile --force`, `rm -rf _build`) and states its cost; running the command again within five minutes passes through untouched. Set SCRY_BUILD_GUARD=0 to disable that hook. A second PreToolUse hook DENIES any dispatch that names no model, because a blank model is not a default -- it silently inherits whatever default is already in place, for the whole run, multiplied across a fan-out. That covers Agent and Workflow dispatch, and metered agent CLIs run through Bash, where an unflagged call falls back to the CLI's own config default; SCRY_METERED_CLIS (default codex) sets which CLIs are covered and SCRY_METERED_CLI_GUARD=0 switches that part off. No model is forbidden; only the absent choice is. On the same surface, a headless `claude -p` run while ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set is refused ONCE with what it will bill -- that run is metered against the API account rather than the subscription -- and the same command repeated within five minutes proceeds; SCRY_API_BILLING_GUARD=0 silences it. A PostToolUse note reports what a premium model draws after it is deliberately chosen, and SCRY_PREMIUM_MODELS sets which models draw it. A further PostToolUse advisory speaks on first contact with a source file that is both large and actively worked, naming what it did not return and what goes wrong silently at that size. Two further ADVISORY hooks inject context and never deny anything. A SubagentStart hook tells a spawned subagent that the worktree it was handed is behind origin/main, by how many commits and days, and how to read the live tip instead -- SessionStart context does not reach a subagent, so an agent otherwise searches a stale tree and reports a feature missing when it merely is not checked out; it fires only when that worktree is on the default branch, it never fetches, and it never moves a ref or a file. A Stop hook reports, at most once per session and only when something is reclaimable, how many linked worktrees the repo has, roughly what they occupy, and how many hold branches already merged into origin/main, then names the cleanup command. SessionEnd would be the obvious event for that and its output reaches no one, which is why it is on Stop; SCRY_WORKTREE_REMINDER_MINUTES (default 45) sets how long a session must run before it speaks, SCRY_WORKTREE_DISK_MB_WARN (default 2048) the size at which an unmerged pile is worth saying out loud. It deletes nothing.
defaultPrompt: Use Scry to check the state of this workspace.
